info.title: ServiceGrid IQ implemented Phase 6 technician and visit API
info.description: Online local core workflow. All mutations require current job version, assignment binding and an idempotency key. Closed outcomes are immutable; observations are append-only. Follow-ups copy context and requirements but never assignments, confirmations or ready approval. Reported usage is not inventory consumption. AWS, offline operation, notifications delivery and production operating safeguards remain deferred.

post.description: Assigned technician or company owner/dispatcher. IN_PROGRESS permits notes, reported usage or corrections. CLOSED permits only notes/corrections tied to the closing assignment. Usage requires exactly one of context part ID/free-text part label and positive quantity. Corrections reference an existing observation in the same job and assignment. No inventory accounting.
